captions: Tabelle 109: Bilanzierung Herstellung Dämmung Mineralwolle mit Alufolie gitterverstärkt Umhüllung
reason: Tabelle 109 (p.172) is the production balance of mineral-wool insulation clad with grid-reinforced aluminium foil ('Alufolie gitterverstärkt Umhüllung') — exactly this dataset. Tabelle 110 on the same page is its disposal counterpart and Tab. 103/105/107 are the same insulation with PVC, aluminium sheet and coarse-grained foil cladding. Tabelle 101 (p.167) gives the insulation-material consumption per pipe dimension that fixes the 40 mm thickness. The range covers p.171-173 for the introducing text and any continuation of Tab. 109.
